newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dublin airport passengers up 14 pct in Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Dublin airport passengers up 14 pct in Jan-Sept.

text.p: Passenger traffic at Dublin airport in the first nine months of 1996 was 14 percent ahead of the same period the previous year, Irish semi-state airport company Aer Rianta said on Wednesday.
Aer Rianta said 7,084,812 passengers passed through Dublin Airport in January to September compared with 6,233,618 in the first nine months of 1995.
Traffic to and from the UK was up 16 percent, while U.S. traffic was up 17 percent and European traffic increased by nine percent.
"From these figures it is confidently expected that Dublin Airport will reach nine million passengers in 1996," Aer Rianta said in a statement.
Passenger traffic at Shannon Airport was up 12 percent to 1,436,928 while Cork Airport traffic grew 17 percent to 895,867, it said.
